question: When was the first battle of Tarain fought?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1191**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The first battle of Tarain **was fought in **1191**.
 
• It was fought between the forces of Prithviraj Chauhan, the king of Delhi, and Muhammad of Ghor, the Sultan of Ghazni.
 
• The battle is considered significant as it marked the beginning of Muslim rule in India.
 
• Prithviraj Chauhan initially gained an advantage in the battle but was eventually defeated due to the betrayal of one of his own generals, who opened the gates of the fort to Muhammad of Ghor.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• 1208 is incorrect as there is no historical record of any significant battle being fought in Tarain during this year.
 
• 1182 is also incorrect as the first battle of Tarain took place almost a decade later.
 
• 1215 is also incorrect as there is no record of any battle being fought in Tarain during this year.
